versions.name: Fly Fishing
versions.description: Balance rod, line, and leader, tie backing, nail, and surgeon's knots, tie your own flies, cast overhead and roll casts to thirty feet, then read what the fish are eating and match the hatch.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
